components.css: .ds-aisle{font-family:var(--font-sans);color:var(--color-ink)}.ds-wires{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;width:70%;height:.75rem;margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;box-sizing:border-box}.ds-wires i{width:2px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-ink-faint) 60%,transparent)}.ds-sign{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;margin:0;border-radius:6px;background:var(--color-sign);color:var(--color-sign-ink);padding:.5rem .75rem;box-shadow:0 6px 12px -8px rgb(0 0 0/.5)}.ds-num{font-family:var(--font-display);font-stretch:118%;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-0.01em;display:grid;place-items:center;height:2rem;min-width:2rem;border-radius:4px;background:var(--color-tag);color:var(--color-tag-ink);font-size:1.125rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-stretch:118%;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-0.01em;flex:1;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.025em;font-size:1rem}.ds-left{font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600;opacity:.85;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-list{margin-top:.5rem;border-radius:6px;border:2px solid var(--color-line);background:var(--color-card)}.ds-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;padding:.625rem 1rem;border-bottom:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-line) 70%,transparent);cursor:pointer}.ds-item:last-child{border:0}.ds-item input{width:1.25rem;height:1.25rem;accent-color:var(--color-sign)}.ds-strike{position:relative}.ds-strike b{color:var(--color-sign);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-strike::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-.15rem;right:-.15rem;top:.68em;height:2px;background:currentColor;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-done{color:var(--color-ink-faint)}.ds-done b{color:inherit}.ds-done::after{transform:scaleX(1)}

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Grocery Aisle"**

The weekly loop is a walk through a grocery store. The shell is a deep green sign band hung over a bright tile-white floor; sections are aisle signs; highlights and selection are shelf-tag yellow; red is kept for things that destroy or fail. Type is store lettering: Archivo pushed wide and heavy for anything that names a place, normal width for everything you read.

Density is working-tool density: compact controls, 2px rules, panels that hold real content rather than decoration. The base size is raised (18px root) so lists stay readable at arm's length in a kitchen. Dark mode is the store after hours: a green-black floor, the signs dimmed to a lit mint, and the yellow tags left on.

Motion is physical and short: the active section sign drops and swings on its hook, list rows rise in with a capped stagger, a checked item gets a line drawn through it like a scanned tag. Reduced motion collapses every one of these to a fade.
keyCharacteristics: Deep aisle-sign green shell, tile-white work area, shelf-tag yellow for selection and numbering.
Archivo variable at width 118 and weight 800 for signs and headings; normal width for body.
Square-ish corners (6px controls, 4px tags) and 2px rules everywhere.
Shelf tags carry a punched hole; aisle groups hang from two wires.
Light and dark from one token set, switched by `data-theme` on the root.

rules.name: The Lit Tag Rule
rules.body: Shelf-Tag Yellow has no dark override. The tags stay lit after hours; never dim or swap them per theme.

rules.name: The Red Means Loss Rule
rules.body: Produce Red appears only on delete, remove and error. Meal categories, favorites and emphasis use green or yellow.

rules.name: The Two-Theme Rule
rules.body: Every color is a token with a light value in `@theme` and a dark value under `:root[data-theme="dark"]`. Components reference tokens, never raw hex.

rules.name: The Sign Lettering Rule
rules.body: Width 118 and weight 800 belong to things that name a place: headings, section tabs, aisle signs, tags and numbers. Body copy, buttons and labels stay at normal width.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any number that lines up with another number uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Only Signs Hang Rule
rules.body: Panels, cards, buttons and dialogs have no drop shadow. A shadow means the element hangs from something.

dos: **Do** take every color from the token set so light and after-hours themes both work without per-component overrides.
**Do** set headings, tabs, tags and numbers in sign lettering (Archivo, width 118, weight 800) and keep reading text at normal width.
**Do** use Shelf-Tag Yellow with Tag Ink for selection, numbering and tags, and keep it identical in dark mode.
**Do** give every animation a reduced-motion fade fallback, and use the shared out-expo ease (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`).
**Do** collapse secondary header and row controls on phones (icon-only, or behind a toggle) before letting rows wrap.
donts: **Don't** use Produce Red for anything but delete, remove and error.
**Don't** add drop shadows to panels, cards, buttons or dialogs; only hanging signs cast one.
**Don't** drift toward cream paper and serif recipe-blog styling, or toward a grey dashboard; the ground is tile white or after-hours green-black.
**Don't** use large rounded corners (anything over 6px) on new surfaces.
